features.placement: 8 radial segments connecting hub (r=15) to rim (r=50). Each spoke is a box of width 8 mm, length 35 mm (50-15), and thickness 8 mm (Y=-4 to Y=4). Spaced at 45-degree intervals in XZ plane.

connections: Spokes connect hub outer surface to rim inner surface.
All features share the same Y-axis thickness range (-4 to 4 mm).
edit_rules: Changing OD updates rim outer radius and spoke length.
Changing thickness updates Y-axis extent of all features.
Changing spoke count updates angular spacing and spoke width if total width is constrained.
